speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Brother? Gilbert. From the Bell, and I've run here from the shop.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am hardly out of the Duke's gown. Say it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: There's been fire again. Last week.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The ostler says half the High Street. A drover says Henley Street. Somebody says forty houses.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Forty is not twenty, and the High Street is not Henley Street. What does Hobbins say.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Twenty, and the north end. He's had three cups and four days in the saddle, and he'll tell me nothing more till he's eaten.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: There's one in Anne's hand, for you, and he'll give it to nobody else. I've not seen it but to look at the seal.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I tell you I don't know. Come and read it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Run, then. God keep— go on.
